'''Winsafra Mmmmm, mind what you have learned, leave the Jedi Council alone''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Plead My Case To The Senate
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Senate Winsafra LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

Basic Strategy, get people out fast for beatdown, i'd play with more EPP's but i dont have em, so i gotta make do.

== Strategy ==

Beat down from coruscant, use menace fades to its full potential! make them come to you, and space, use it as long as you can, then let it go. im thinkin of switchin space to a couple liberty's, home one, and a couple EPP falcons and punch it's. if time's get desperate, use 4 force to send jedi backup wherever you need it! :)
lemme know what you think
carl
